name: inspect_weight_subspace
description: Extract and inspect low-rank SVD singular modes, dominant directional vectors, or coordinate extreme blocks of a specific tensor within a safetensors or GGUF file using memory mapping. Never loads full model into memory. Returns compact singular values, directional vectors, and an authenticated Evidence record.

path.description: Absolute filesystem path to the local .safetensors or .gguf model file.

tensor_name.description: Exact tensor name to inspect, e.g. 'model.layers.14.self_attn.o_proj.weight'.

top_k.description: Number of dominant singular modes or extreme values to extract (max 64).
